title: Support the open Agent Skills standard
description:
## Summary
- add support for the open Agent Skills standard so we can reuse community-defined capabilities
- integrate https://agentskills.io/home so Tactus agents can load prebuilt skills and better share workflows

## Benefits
- unlocks a catalog of off-the-shelf skills
- reduces duplication for new capabilities by reusing existing skills
- aligns the project with an interoperable format that other agent platforms already adopt

## Additional Context
See the standard homepage for details: https://agentskills.io/home
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Added Agent Skills loader with SKILL.md parsing and system prompt manifest injection plus tests
